equivalents.mutant: x[i]! < y[i]! -> x[i]! <= y[i]! (utf8Order, the second comparison on the line)
equivalents.reason: this comparison is reached only when x[i] !== y[i], so `<` and `<=` give the same answer
the equal-length case is answered by the `x.length === y.length ? 0 :` branch before this comparison, so `<` and `<=` give the same answer
`at` is only compared with `at >= 0` and used as an index when it is not negative; -1 and -2 are both 'no base_sepolia member found'

the supplied pairs are added only for names the section does not hold, so no key is repeated, and goEncode sorts every object's keys by their UTF-8 bytes before writing: the order of the pair list never reaches the output
